```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

```

```{r}
BreedingSites<-read.csv("./data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(BreedingSites)
print(paste0("The column names are ",
             paste(colnames(BreedingSites),collapse = ",")))
#summarise the data
glimpse(BreedingSites)

print(nrow(BreedingSites))
print(ncol(BreedingSites))
print(dim(BreedingSites))
```

We now move on to the data about the stopover locations and other migration sites

```{r}
Migratory<-read.csv("./data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(Migratory))
glimpse(Migratory)
print(paste0("There are ",nrow(Migratory)," rows and ",ncol(Migratory)," columns"))
glimpse(Migratory$Tag) #character
glimpse(Migratory$Birth) #integer
```


Now we filter the dataset to the relevant columns.

```{r}
BreedingSites<-read.csv("./data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
bird_breeding_selected <- BreedingSites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |> #select unique rows
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)

Migratory<-read.csv("./data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
bird_migration_selected<-Migratory |>
  select(Site,winterLongitude,winterLatitude,pslon,pslat,
         iblon,iblat,awestlon,awestlat)|>
  distinct()|>
  rename(
    Winter_Longitude=winterLongitude,
    Winter_Latitude=winterLatitude,
    Stopover_Longitude=pslon,
    Stopover_Latitude=pslat,
    Iberian_Longitude=iblon,
    Iberian_Latitude=iblat,
    Westmost_Longitude=awestlon,
    Westmost_Latitude=awestlat
  )
gt(bird_migration_selected)

```

Now we filter the data frames
```{r}
bird_breeding_dartmoor <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site == "Dartmoor")

gt(bird_breeding_dartmoor)
bird_breeding_not_dartmoor <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Dartmoor")

gt(bird_breeding_not_dartmoor)

bird_breeding_long_10 <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Breeding_Longitude > 10)

gt(bird_breeding_long_10)
```

We filter out Spain from the data as there is no post-Saharan stopover data in this location

```{r}
bird_breeding_exc <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(bird_breeding_exc)

bird_migration_exc <-bird_migration_selected |> filter(Site !="Spain")
gt(bird_migration_exc)
```
